name: Bead (free font made for 3D-printed text)
summary: Free OFL font by Printago designed for FDM printing: every stroke is exactly two extrusion lines wide, so small names, serial numbers and labels slice as clean walls instead of gap fill. Comes in Small/Medium/Large sizes, each in raised, Cut (debossed) and Open (cut-in, printed face down) variants, with a nozzle-to-size table and test 3MF files.

access.notes: SIL OFL 1.1 with Reserved Font Name Bead: free for personal and commercial use and embedding; font files may not be sold on their own; modified versions must be renamed.

procedure: Open https://printago.io/bead and click Download the font
Unzip bead-fonts.zip (9 TTF files + OFL + README)
Pick Small/Medium/Large and the raised, Cut or Open variant
Set the font size from the README table for your nozzle (e.g. 0.4 mm nozzle: Small = 8.0 mm font size)

verdict.why: Niche but genuinely useful: a free OFL typeface engineered for the slicer (0 gap fill in Printago's OrcaSlicer comparison against 12 fonts), with direct zip download and no signup. Comparison data is the publisher's own.
